el.Transformo la realidad en otra posibilid: I turn reality into another possibility through images.
el.Construyo imágenes, situaciones e imagin: I build images, situations and imaginaries.
el.Autorretratos intervenidos: el cuerpo co: Altered self-portraits: the body as nourishment. Winner at FAPA 2021 and Silver Medal at TIFA 2020.
el.Una serie que empecé en 2014 tras la mue: A series I began in 2014 after the sudden death of a young member of my family. Since then, my gaze has become more sensitive to the presence and absence of life in the creatures that appear in everyday life. Exhibited at Pinta BAphoto 2026.
el.Autorretratos de un miércoles cualquiera: Self-portraits of an ordinary Wednesday: humor, confinement and memento mori.
el.Collage e intervención digital, el circo: Collage and digital intervention, the circus as a stage, and studio portraits with an almost theatrical staging. First Prize from the Julia Margaret Cameron Foundation (United Kingdom, 2019) for “Poptitud”.
el.Nací en Buenos Aires. Estudié Diseño Grá: I was born in Buenos Aires. I studied Graphic Design, Social Communication and Advertising, and worked in creative direction at several agencies before mutating into a visual artist.
el.En 2014 empecé a exhibir mis trabajos fo: In 2014 I began showing my photographic work on social media, at fairs and in group shows, eventually reaching museums and solo exhibitions in Argentina and abroad. Since 2018 I have run Espacio Disparos, my studio and gallery: a space to create, produce and exhibit ideas.
el.Además de mi obra, hago trabajos editori: Besides my own work, I do editorial and advertising projects, as well as commissioned studio portraits.
Portrait, self-portrait and staged photography. I build images, situations and imaginaries to transform reality into another possibility.
el.Retratos de estudio, trabajos editoriale: Studio portraits, editorial and advertising work.
el.Ganadora en FAPA (Fine Art Photography A: Winner at FAPA (Fine Art Photography Awards), Conceptual Photography category, with the series “Víveres”.
el.Medalla de Plata en TIFA (Tokio Internat: Silver Medal at TIFA (Tokio International Foto Awards), portfolio category, for “Víveres”. Silver Medal at BIFA (Budapest International Foto Awards), fine art portfolio, for “Aislamiento Pop”.
el.Dos menciones honoríficas en el Prix de: Two honorable mentions at the Prix de la Photographie de Paris: self-portraits evoking Eva Perón and the series “Mi propio circo”. Grand Prize from Curator’s Voice in Miami at the exhibition “The Art in Isolation”.
el.Primer Premio de la Fundación Julia Marg: First Prize from the Julia Margaret Cameron Foundation (United Kingdom), Collage and Digital Intervention category, for “Poptitud”. Selected by the Centro de Fotografía de Montevideo for Roger Ballen’s seminar.
